C0066.title: Hainan Man Sentenced for Fraud via Fake Second-Hand Billiard Cue Ads
C0066.summary: In July 2025, Lingao County People's Court disclosed that a local man surnamed Lao posted fake advertisements for second-hand billiard cues on social platforms and collected RMB 3,400 after gaining the trust of a victim surnamed Yin. The court convicted Lao of fraud, sentenced him to four months of criminal detention, and fined him RMB 1,000.
